articles.title: SS United States Lies in Disrepair on Mobile River Bank
articles.summary: The SS United States, once a proud symbol of American maritime power, now lies in disrepair on the banks of Mobile River in Alabama.
articles.content: The SS United States, once a proud symbol of American maritime power, now lies in disrepair on the banks of Mobile River in Alabama. Past train tracks and deserted lots, this colossal vessel has been reduced to a shadow of its former self, its original red, white, and blue paint faded by rust and neglect. Measuring nearly 1,000 feet in length, the SS United States was always an extraordinary ship, boasting five more decks than the ill-fated RMS Titanic and a record-breaking speed that left all others behind. The ocean liner's heyday was marked by glamorous transatlantic crossings, with A-listers like Marilyn Monroe, Salvador Dalí, and Marlon Brando among its frequent passengers. Built in the early 1950s, it set sail on its maiden voyage from New York City to the UK in July 1952, achieving an unprecedented speed of just 3 days, 10 hours, and 40 minutes. The SS United States was more than just a luxury liner; it also played host to notable figures from politics, including former presidents Harry Truman and Dwight Eisenhower, and first ladies like Eleanor Roosevelt. Today, the ship's grandeur is tempered by its surroundings, a county jail, vacant lots, and past train tracks, but even in decline, it remains an awe-inspiring sight. The SS United States's glory days were short-lived, marked by a swift decline after just 17 years of passenger travel. A combination of factors led to its demise: affordable air travel made it harder for the ship to compete, rising oil and labor costs further squeezed profits, and government subsidies that once sustained it eventually dried up. The ship has spent nearly six decades in limbo, being bought and sold by various parties seeking a new purpose for this majestic vessel. In a surprising turn of events, the SS United States is now set to become an artificial reef off the coast of Destin, Florida, where it will provide a habitat for dozens of species of fish and other marine life. On November 12, the liner will be intentionally sunk into the ocean floor, marking a new chapter in its history as a recreational destination for divers and fishermen. The narrow plank leading up to the ship's port side was a precursor to what lay ahead - a journey through the remnants of luxury and grandeur. Inside, the light was scarce, filtering in from gaps where windows and portholes had once stood, casting eerie shadows on the walls. A spiral staircase wound its way up two floors above, where first-class cabins had once been the epitome of elegance. Now, outlines of floor plans remained etched into the metal, alongside shower and toilet drains that hinted at the opulence of bygone days. The grand staircase, though partially intact, led to a promenade deck once lined with floor-to-ceiling windows, now exposed to the elements. The empty lounges where martinis were no doubt served in their heyday still held an air of sophistication, even if it was now tinged with neglect. As we navigated through the ship's interior, I couldn't help but imagine the ghosts of jazz bands past playing on hollowed-out stages. The captain's dining room, once the preserve of elite guests, now hosted a different kind of diner - spiders scurrying across the tables. The ecosystem surrounding the ship will likely take at least a year to fully establish itself after it sinks into the waters off Destin-Fort Walton Beach. A key factor contributing to this delay is the lack of natural reefs and habitats in these waters, which are typical in other parts of Florida. However, artificial reefs can provide an alternative environment for marine life to thrive, compensating for the absence of natural features. More than 600 artificial reefs have been installed in the area since 2017, thanks in part to the efforts of local leaders who recognize their potential to boost diving and fishing opportunities. The SS United States was identified as a prime candidate to become one of these artificial reefs after being located by Fogg through online research. The SS United States was purchased from the conservancy after various deals to refurbish or repurpose the ship fell through, including a plan to turn it into a recreational destination at Pier 76 in Manhattan. A major challenge lay ahead: getting the massive vessel out of Philadelphia and transported to its final resting place. A detailed survey and negotiations with the Coast Guard were necessary before the ship could begin its journey. The SS United States finally arrived in Mobile, Alabama, in March 2025, where it underwent an extensive environmental remediation process to prepare it for its new life as an artificial reef. Years earlier, asbestos had been removed from the cabins, but a specialized team still had work to do. The ship's fuel tanks, ventilation system, and other hazardous materials were carefully cleaned out and disposed of responsibly. The elevators, which were covered in grease, were also removed to facilitate the sinking process and allow air to escape quickly. The sinking process has been designed to be more controlled and less destructive than in the past, with explosives no longer used. Instead, valves connected to large boiler pipes will be opened to allow water to flood into the ship. According to calculations by a naval architect on the project, it is estimated that the SS United States will be fully submerged within 45 minutes of these valves being opened. This means that the wreck can be quickly surveyed and any remaining equipment removed, such as IMAX cameras that have been mounted to capture footage of the sinking. The next day after the sinking, Fogg expects a group of recreational divers to arrive on site, eager to explore the newly submerged ship. Above water, visitor center exhibits and a land-based museum will also soon open, showcasing artifacts and stories from the SS United States' past that have been carefully preserved by the conservancy. The SS United States will once again become a source of wonder and delight for the public, with Jones taking comfort in knowing that the ship's legacy will live on through these exhibits and museums. articles.title: Bull shark spotted at Great Sea Reef in northeast Fiji
articles.summary: A scuba diver witnessed a majestic bull shark in its natural habitat while exploring the Great Sea Reef in northeast Fiji.
articles.content: A scuba diver's dream come true: witnessing a majestic bull shark in its natural habitat. The creature emerged from the depths of the South Pacific Ocean in an instant, its imposing size and bulk evident even at 60 feet below. Floating alongside the shark were two remora fish, their sleek bodies gliding effortlessly through the water as if guarding their larger companion. The bull shark itself moved with surprising speed, given its considerable girth, as it swam just above the sandy sea floor. As the shark turned in the water, a wall of vibrant coral rose up from the depths to the right, a kaleidoscope of colors - neon green, milky orange, and soft pink - that seemed almost otherworldly. Meanwhile, deep water beckoned to the left, an endless expanse of blue that stretched out into the distance. A fellow diver floated nearby, clad in a striking speckled camouflage wetsuit that blended seamlessly with the surrounding environment. His wild hair was visible above his mask, and he gave a nod of acknowledgement as he flattened the side of his hand against his head - a universal sign for one of the most coveted sightings in diving: a shark. The sighting was all the more remarkable given the relatively unknown status of the Great Sea Reef, a 280-mile-long underwater paradise in northeast Fiji. This coral reef system is not only home to an astonishing array of marine life but also boasts a staggering three-quarters of all known coral species and over half of all recognized fish. As a hub for conservation research, the Great Sea Reef is gaining recognition, with organizations such as PADI AWARE and the World Wildlife Fund launching initiatives to promote community-backed ocean conservation. In July 2026, a new partnership was announced to take this effort forward. A groundbreaking collaboration between PADI AWARE and WWF is revolutionizing the way we approach marine conservation by harnessing the power of scuba diving communities worldwide. The Global Shark & Ray Census project aims to collect vital data that can inform governments in Fiji and beyond about the creation of new Marine Protected Areas, a crucial step towards safeguarding coral reefs. PADI AWARE's programs director Ian Campbell is driving this ambitious initiative forward by bringing together PADI's vast network of certified divers and dive centers with WWF's conservation efforts spanning over 100 countries. As I explored the Great Sea Reef, I was struck by the unique opportunity for travelers to experience this ecosystem firsthand while contributing to a pioneering approach to coral reef protection. My morning dive was filled with excitement when we spotted a lone bull shark, which I documented in my waterproof notebook with a simple yet satisfying "bull shark: 1. The notes from that dive were just the beginning of the data collection process, and it was only when we returned to land that our logging efforts would truly begin. The winding path leading to Nukubati resort was flanked by coconut trees whose angled heights seemed to stretch up towards the sky. Opened in 1992 by Jenny Leewai and her Australian husband Peter Bourke, this Fijian resort has been a family affair for two generations. Nestled on the shores of the Great Sea Reef, Nukubati is the only property located within the reef's boundaries, making it an ideal base for exploring the area. After each dive, guests would return to the resort and be greeted by its tranquil atmosphere, complete with custom-ordered cane palm furniture and gleaming wooden floors that seemed to reflect the light of the sun. The private bure where I stayed was a cozy haven, equipped with all the necessary amenities, including a hot shower that helped wash away the fatigue of the dive. As I joined the others at the open-air lounge, nicknamed the pavilion, I couldn't help but notice the relaxed atmosphere that pervaded the resort. Jenny and Lara were already seated on the couch, looking every bit the epitome of island elegance in their casual attire, with Jenny sporting a caftan and Champagne-colored pearls. As we made our way back to shore after spotting those sharks, I took out my phone and logged the sighting on the PADI AWARE app. It was quick and straightforward - just a few minutes of tapping through details like our location, activity, maximum depth, and the types of sharks we'd seen. We marked Fish Market as our dive site, recorded our underwater excursion as diving, noted that we hadn't gone below 60 feet, and identified the species we'd encountered. The census has gained significant traction since its launch in April 2026, with over 212,000 people participating worldwide and submitting thousands of sightings. These reports are then reviewed by PADI AWARE staff, who work closely with experts from the James Cook University Centre for Sustainable Tropical Fisheries and Aquaculture in Australia to ensure the accuracy of the data. Researchers have already made use of this information - a scientific paper currently under review has incorporated some of the census findings. Moreover, images submitted through the app have helped confirm the presence of four shark and ray species in Vanuatu. The great hammerhead shark is among those species, listed as Critically Endangered" on the IUCN Red List due to its impressive size - up to 20 feet long - and mysterious mating behaviors. Fiji's Marine Protected Areas have proven to be a successful model for conservation, safeguarding reefs for both locals and travelers while providing new economic opportunities for communities. Nukubati Resort stands out as an exemplary case of how tourism can positively impact the environment and local economies, often without visitors even realizing it at first. The resort has been a hub for sustainable practices and eco-friendly initiatives that benefit both the surrounding ecosystem and its guests. During my stay at Nukubati, I had the privilege of witnessing multiple shark and ray species thriving in their natural habitat, free from human influence such as feeding or baiting. This was not an isolated incident; every single dive I went on featured these incredible creatures. The statistics are certainly eye-opening, making diving on the Great Sea Reef an attractive option for both seasoned scuba enthusiasts and beginners alike. With options available for snorkelers, beginner divers, and advanced divers, there's something for everyone to enjoy in this unique marine environment. As a PADI scuba diving instructor with extensive experience worldwide, Vincent was keenly aware of the reef's significance during our excursion. He pointed out that the absence of sharks on every dive was indeed remarkable, especially considering we were the only boat present at the site. The Great Sea Reef holds a special place in the hearts and histories of local communities, who have revered it for generations through songs, stories, and cultural traditions. Its importance extends beyond its natural beauty to its role as a protector of their community's heritage. Locals like Leone are now being recognized as traditional stakeholders in the GSR's future, a shift that acknowledges their deep connection to the reef. Their unshakeable faith in the reef's importance is evident in the way they've nurtured Nukubati Island Resort, which has endured numerous challenges and still remains a tranquil hideaway for just 14 guests. The property's resilience can be attributed to its strong family and community bonds, with all 100 staff members being local residents who have helped keep it afloat through thick and thin. Nukubati has also been at the forefront of sustainability, having run on solar power since its inception in the 1990s, thanks to co-founder Peter's hand-engineered system. The recognition of Nukubati as a PADI Eco Center in September 2026 marked a significant milestone for the resort and its operator, Great Sea Reef Divers, which demonstrated their commitment to conservation and sustainability. This designation has allowed Leone and his team to contribute to global initiatives, such as logging shark and ray sightings in the new census, and encouraging visitors to participate in these efforts. As they dive into the crystal-clear waters of the GSR, Leone's enthusiasm is palpable, with no regrets about their decision to prioritize conservation over commercial interests. Miuccia Prada's collection featured 63 distinct looks, each showcasing a unique take on the skirt in various colors and fabrics. While the silhouette of the skirts may have seemed fresh and innovative under the spring collections' glamorous lights, they actually made a similar impact during the fall shows. However, it's worth noting that the primary message wasn't necessarily about the garment itself. As the temperature drops, people naturally turn to clothing that offers maximum coverage, often opting for pants in thick wool or denim. But with the weather becoming brisker, there is still hope for the skirt's resurgence. As autumn's chill sets in, outdoor enthusiasts are flocking to the countryside for a breath of fresh air and a change of scenery. Country pursuits like hiking and horseback riding offer a great way to get some exercise while taking in the vibrant fall foliage. Dressing for a day outdoors requires layers that can keep up with changing weather conditions. A long, box-pleated corduroy skirt paired with a lightweight cashmere turtleneck and a plaid shirt provides a comfortable and practical outfit for exploring the great outdoors. Mixing suede and turquoise accents is a key element in channeling the New Western look without going overboard. Pairing these elements with more everyday pieces, such as a concho belt or jewelry, adds a touch of elegance to an otherwise rugged ensemble. To add some flair to your fall wardrobe, think about combining classic pieces with more adventurous elements. A vintage-inspired gray hoodie can be paired with high-shaft boots featuring croc-embossed details that evoke a rugged Old West feel without going over the top. While muted tones and neutrals are often a safe choice for fall dressing, don't be afraid to introduce some brighter colors into your outfit. You could incorporate an interesting pop of red or purple, which is especially fitting during this time of year. The key is to balance bold hues with more subdued pieces. Consider pairing a vibrant taffeta ball skirt in a pinkish-red shade with a coordinating button-down shirt and a statement-making ring featuring peridot stones surrounded by studded enamel starfish designs. This look would be perfect for hosting friends or attending holiday gatherings, adding a touch of personality to your overall ensemble. To balance out a leather skirt's edginess, try pairing it with a simple white T-shirt and a V-neck sweater in a muted gray tone. This subtle combination helps to soften the overall look without compromising its downtown cool factor. The result is a stylish ensemble perfect for everyday wear. For a more relaxed office look, consider swapping out heels or boots for slip-on loafers. This understated footwear choice pairs well with a utilitarian skirt and lets personal style take center stage. Office attire has indeed become more laid-back in recent years, allowing individuals to express their unique sense of fashion. When incorporating bold animal prints into your wardrobe, remember that they can be statement pieces on their own. Pairing them with understated items like striped monk-collar shirts or knitted vests in unexpected color combinations adds visual interest and creates a chic look. These contrasting elements work well together, making the overall ensemble truly eye-catching. The skirt's bold print demands to be noticed, so pair it with understated basics like a black cashmere T-shirt with short sleeves and a wool cardigan to let the eye-catching pattern take center stage. This well-balanced combination prevents the overall look from feeling overwhelming, allowing the wearer's personality to shine through in the statement-making skirt. I've had the opportunity to talk to Vanella about his experience on The Traitors: New Blood, and it's given me insight into what makes him tick. We discussed various topics, including how his wife feels about his lying skills and being recognized at funerals he's overseeing. Vanella has always been a private person, but his newfound fame has forced him to open up about certain aspects of his life. articles.title: Black Doves Season 2 Lands on Netflix Screens
articles.summary: The second season of the spy thriller picks up where the first left off, introducing new plot threads and characters amidst unresolved storylines.
articles.content: The highly anticipated second season of Netflix's spy thriller Black Doves has finally landed on screens, bringing back fan-favorite characters and introducing new faces to the mix. A covert intelligence organization at its core, Black Doves delves into the world of espionage where secrets are bought and sold among the wealthy and influential. Season two picks up where the first left off, with many plot threads still unresolved, setting the stage for a gripping narrative. Among the returning cast members is Keira Knightley as Helen Webb, an agent struggling to balance her life as a spy with her roles as a politician's wife and mother. Her character's moral ambiguity is central to the show's appeal, as she navigates the complexities of her clandestine work. Ben Whishaw reprises his role as Sam Young, a former Black Doves employee turned hit man who attempted to leave his past behind but found it difficult to escape. With new characters joining the fray, season two promises to be even more action-packed and unpredictable than its predecessor. The stakes are high in Black Doves season two, with Helen's clandestine life taking center stage amidst her marriage woes and security concerns for her prime minister husband. As Reed, Sarah Lancashire brings a sense of unease to the role of spymaster, never backing down from tough decisions that put everyone at risk. Her character is multifaceted, revealing new vulnerabilities through flashbacks to pivotal moments in her past. Meanwhile, Andrew Buchan's portrayal of Wallace Webb presents a stark contrast to Helen's covert activities, as he remains oblivious to her Black Doves involvement despite the increasing strain on their marriage. Ella Lily Hyland reprises her role as Williams, shifting allegiances from Lenny's crime syndicate to a new partnership with Eleanor and a budding friendship with Sam. The cast of Black Doves continues to grow in season 2, welcoming new faces alongside familiar ones. One notable addition is Gabrielle Creevy as Eleanor, Williams's partner and a skilled assassin with a witty sense of humor. Creevy has an extensive filmography, having appeared in Amadeus, The Guest, and Operation Mincemeat among other projects. Her diverse experience brings depth to the character of Eleanor. New characters are also introduced, including Ambika Mod as Laila, an assassin with a unique personality that sets her apart from the rest. Laila's lighthearted nature creates tension when she clashes with Helen at the start of season 2. The introduction of Babou Ceesay as Mr. Conteh adds another layer to the story, as he becomes increasingly prominent in the Black Doves institution and its dealings. Katia Chernov, a sharp-witted and glamorous woman, is swept up in the mysteries of season 2 as the wife of Russian oligarch Alexi Chernov. Her character brings a new layer to the story, showcasing her intelligence and influence. Alexi Chernov, played by Goran Kostić, is a powerful and well-connected figure with a significant presence in the fragile cases of season 2. His character's complexities are likely to be explored further, given his extensive influence and power. articles.title: Ancient Egyptian Language's Lasting Influence on English Vocabulary

articles.content: Ancient Egyptian language has left an enduring legacy in English, with many of its words still widely used today without their origins being recognized. The language was spoken along the Nile for thousands of years and was picked up by Greek traders and Roman writers who passed it on to other cultures. Some of these borrowed words made their way into Arabic and Spanish before eventually reaching English. Now, etymologists have identified nine everyday words that are believed to have originated in ancient Egypt. The language's influence can be seen in the many loanwords that have been incorporated into various languages over time. The process often began with traders or writers who traveled along trade routes and adopted words from other cultures. These borrowed words then spread through linguistic exchange, with each culture adding its own twist before passing them on to others. The trail of these loanwords can be complex and sometimes unclear. The word "paper is one such example that has a clear path back to ancient Egypt. It entered English in the mid-14th century via Old French, which borrowed it from Latin. However, the Latin term itself was derived from papyrus, the reed plant used by the Ancient Egyptians as a writing surface. The Greeks also referred to this plant as papyros, a word that is often claimed to be of Egyptian origin. Despite its widespread use today, the origins of the word paper are not commonly known. Few people recognize that their printer trays and notebooks owe a debt to ancient Egypt's innovative use of papyrus. The story of how this word traveled from the Nile to modern times is a testament to the power of linguistic exchange. The Greek term papyros has been identified as a loanword of unknown origin, which some etymologists claim may have been Egyptian in origin. If true, it would mean that the Ancient Egyptians played a significant role in developing writing materials and that their innovations were adopted by other cultures over time. As linguists continue to study the history of words, they are uncovering more examples of ancient Egyptian loanwords. The process is often complex and requires tracing the path of each word through various languages over thousands of years. Despite these challenges, researchers remain committed to understanding how languages have evolved and interacted with one another. The trail of linguistic exchange that has led to the spread of words from ancient Egypt is a fascinating example of human communication and cultural exchange. As we continue to explore the history of language, it becomes clear that the influence of ancient Egyptian on modern English is more significant than previously thought. The ancient Egyptians had a term, hbnj, that referred to a dense, dark wood highly valued for its carving properties. This term likely influenced the Greek word ebenos, which in turn was adapted by the Romans into ebenus. The English language borrowed ebony from Latin in the 1590s, and it wasn't long before writers began using the term to describe a deep, rich black color. As a result of this linguistic evolution, words related to ebony now appear in various contexts beyond woodworking. For example, poetry often employs imagery evoking dark hues reminiscent of ebony, while piano lessons frequently mention the instrument's ebony keys. Paint-chip names also draw inspiration from the term, highlighting its widespread influence on language. Before English adopted the word ivory from French in the 13th century, Old English speakers referred to it as elpendban, or elephant bone. The etymology of this newer term points back to Latin ebur, which likely originated from an African source through Phoenician intermediaries. Egyptian and Coptic languages also played a role in its development, with the term ab signifying elephant" and ebu meaning "ivory. The word ivory has undergone significant semantic shifts over time. Initially used to describe elephant tusks, it later became slang for teeth by 1782. By the early 19th century, ivories had taken on a new meaning, piano keys made from this material. In addition to its association with piano keys, ivory has also been linked to other objects and concepts. Its connection to elephant tusks is well-documented, as is its use in art and craftsmanship throughout history. The complex etymology of the word ivory highlights the dynamic nature of language, which often borrows from multiple sources to create new meanings and associations. The term adobe has an unexpected origin in ancient Egypt. A mud brick found in New Mexico still carries a name that was used on the banks of the Nile thousands of years ago. The word adobe entered English from Spanish in 1739 and was later linked to the Arabic al-tob, which means the brick. This connection was made by 19th-century Dutch Arabist Reinhart Dozy, who had spent years studying ancient languages. A different theory suggests that adobe comes from the Spanish verb adobar, meaning to plaster, but if Dozy's theory holds true, then the mud bricks in New Mexico still bear a name with Egyptian roots. The path of language is often complex and winding, as seen in the case of adobe. Despite its widespread use today, the word has an intimate connection to ancient Egypt. A more direct link between English and ancient Egypt can be found in the term oasis. This word entered English through Latin from Greek Oasis, which was derived from the Egyptian wḥꜣt. According to Middle Egyptian dictionaries compiled by scholars like Raymond Faulkner, the word wḥꜣt had multiple meanings, including oasis" and "cauldron. As language evolved over time, its meaning shifted and adapted. The Coptic language, an ancestor of modern Arabic, retains a connection to ancient Egypt through words such as ouahe, which is linked to the Egyptian wḥꜣt. This shows how languages have borrowed from each other throughout history, often creating new meanings and associations along the way. The word gum has a long and winding path that begins in ancient Egypt. The Egyptians called this sticky substance qmyt, which referred specifically to resin. Over time, this term was borrowed by the Greeks, who modified it to kommi, and later the Latin speakers adopted it as gummi. This early meaning of gum has nothing to do with the modern chewing gum that people enjoy today. That particular product came much later and simply inherited its name from the earlier substance. Meanwhile, the word for the gums in your mouth is a completely different term, derived from Old English gōma, which means palate. The linguistic connections between ancient cultures are often surprising and intriguing. A case in point is the Egyptian word baris, which referred to a specific type of boat used on the Nile River. The Greeks borrowed this term and modified it to their own word, baris. This borrowing of words from one language to another can create complex paths that are difficult to follow. articles.title: Climate change pushes planet beyond comfort zone
articles.summary: A new study reveals that rising temperatures are pushing the Earth's climate beyond its stable conditions, threatening complex societies and ecosystems.
articles.content: A new study published in a leading scientific journal has sounded the alarm on the devastating impact of climate change on the world's ice reserves. The research reveals that the stable conditions that have allowed human civilization to thrive for thousands of years are rapidly disappearing. For the past 12,000 years, the Earth's climate has been remarkably consistent, enabling the development of complex societies and ecosystems. Rising temperatures, however, are pushing the planet beyond its comfort zone, threatening the very foundation of our existence. Scientists have identified a "safe operating space" for the cryosphere, the icy, snowy landscape that covers much of the globe. By analyzing changes to polar sea ice, land ice, glaciers, permafrost, and snow cover over the past 12 millennia, researchers have pinpointed the boundaries beyond which the stability of these ecosystems would be compromised. The findings are alarming: Arctic and Antarctic sea ice have both fallen outside the safe operating threshold, as have snow cover and the area of permafrost, a frozen soil layer that stores massive amounts of carbon. The world's land ice is still within its safe operating threshold, but it's perilously close to falling outside of it. Warming that has already been locked into the climate system suggests that this tipping point will likely be crossed in the coming centuries. This reality may seem distant and abstract, but it has far-reaching consequences for regions around the globe, from the icy expanses of Antarctica to the frozen tundras of Alaska. Any decline of these vast ice sheets would have catastrophic effects on global sea levels, with the West Antarctic Ice Sheet alone capable of raising ocean waters by a staggering 11 feet. The notion that crossing into this new zone will immediately unleash catastrophic sea level rise is a misconception. The risk of triggering tipping points is increasing, but it's not a guarantee of imminent disaster. According to Noström, venturing above 5 degrees Celsius would be akin to playing with fire, potentially setting off some of the Earth system's most critical thresholds. The safe operating space framework takes into account slower changes over time and how far the cryosphere is straying from conditions that have historically supported a stable Earth system. This broader perspective sheds light on the alarming rate at which our planet's ice is deviating from its comfort zone. Cutting emissions remains the most direct way to halt the cryosphere's slide, but some scientists are now advocating for more drastic measures to safeguard global ice reserves. Geoengineering approaches to combat the effects of climate change have been explored by researchers, who are considering techniques such as pumping cold sea water to the surface to thicken ice and building manmade barriers to stabilize vulnerable ice sheets. These interventions would be costly and come with no guarantee of success, but Noström emphasizes that reducing emissions is still the most pressing priority for safeguarding global ice reserves. articles.content: The College Football Playoff picture has become increasingly clearer following another week of intense competition. Kentucky's chances of securing a bye have dwindled significantly, while Notre Dame reinforced its position in the rankings by defeating previously top-ranked Miami. Last week's losses suffered by No. 19 Ole Miss and No. 20 Ohio State likely sealed their fate outside the playoff bracket. Meanwhile, No. 21 LSU is on the cusp of elimination, with its chances hanging precariously in the balance. The coming weeks will undoubtedly bring more eliminations as teams struggle to stay afloat. Seven games this weekend hold major College Football Playoff implications, each carrying significant weight for contenders and pretenders alike. These matchups represent critical junctures that could either propel teams forward or consign them to playoff oblivion. The USC-Indiana showdown on Saturday is particularly pivotal, with the Trojans positioned near the top of the rankings after their upset over Ohio State. Indiana boasts an elite defense, having limited its last five opponents to fewer than 20 points. Yet, despite a bye week, the Hoosiers have slipped in the CFP Rankings and now face a must-win scenario against the Trojans, who are still reeling from their earlier loss to Wisconsin. The stakes are high for Texas as they prepare to face LSU on the road, a game that could determine their chances of hosting a College Football Playoff matchup later in the season. With an unblemished record against ranked opponents this year, the Longhorns have the potential to move up the rankings and challenge Alabama's top spot with a win over the Tigers. LSU is fighting for its postseason life after suffering its third consecutive loss to a ranked team, a trend that has put their playoff hopes in jeopardy. While they still have two ranked opponents left on their schedule - No. 6 Texas and No. 8 Tennessee - it's unclear whether these wins will be enough to salvage their season. The matchup between Oklahoma State and Texas Tech is shaping up to be an explosive affair, with the Cowboys boasting one of the top offenses in the Big 12 behind quarterback Drew Mestemaker. For Texas Tech, this game represents a crucial opportunity to pick up a much-needed win and get back on track after falling out of playoff contention. Oklahoma State's chances of making the College Football Playoff may seem slim at first glance given their No. 25 ranking and three losses, but there is still a pathway for them to crack the field. Beating a top-ranked team like Texas Tech could help them gain momentum and move closer to the threshold that separates playoff contenders from those on the outside looking in. Wake Forest is looking to solidify its position in the postseason race by defeating SMU in their upcoming matchup. Gio Lopez, the Demon Deacons' quarterback, has been flying under the radar despite his impressive skills on the field. He will face off against Kevin Jennings, a talented player from SMU, in what promises to be an intense battle. The winner of this game will take over the inside track to play Miami in the ACC Championship Game. Despite managing just six games, Lacy still managed to accumulate respectable numbers with 388 yards and five touchdowns under his belt. The contrast between Lacy's current season and his breakout performance in 2025 is stark. Last year, he was a dominant force for Ole Miss, leading the country with an impressive 306 attempts that yielded 1,567 yards and 24 touchdowns. The next move for Lacy will be crucial in determining his NFL prospects. With a strong case to be one of the top running back picks in the draft, he now faces a tough decision: to return to college or take his chances at the professional level. The NFL draft prospects of a talented running back have taken a significant hit after a disappointing season. At 5-foot-11 and 205 pounds, he may struggle to compete against larger opponents. His size is not the only factor, however, as there are also doubts about his health due to a recent injury. The NFL draft landscape for running backs is becoming increasingly uncertain, with teams seeming to favor other positions in recent years. Only three first-round running backs have been selected in the last five drafts, and the past two classes have yielded underwhelming results. The success of previous picks will likely influence how teams view this player's chances. The Ole Miss star running back's season has been cut short due to injury, leaving his NFL Draft prospects uncertain. Returning to college for another year isn't a sure thing either, and considering his recent injuries, it's possible that Lacy's stock could take a hit if he suffers another setback in 2027. This would likely result in a much lower draft position than what he was aiming for, which might not be worth the risk. articles.title: Android Users Can Unlock More Functionality with Developer Options
articles.summary: Android users familiar with the Settings app know that it provides a wide range of features and options. However, there's a hidden feature called Developer Options that can be enabled to...
articles.content: Android users familiar with the Settings app know that it provides a wide range of features and options. However, there's a hidden feature called Developer Options that can be enabled to offer even more functionality. This Developer Options feature is often overlooked by casual Android users but can be extremely useful for those who want to fine-tune their device settings. But what if you're looking for something more comprehensive? Enter Essentials, an app that serves as a power-user's toolbox with over 30 mods and tweaks. These features range from simple ones like button remapping and wallpaper customization to more complex options such as notification management and Always-On Display. To use Essentials, your Android device must be running version 8 or newer. Some advanced features may require additional tools or root access, but the majority of users will find that they can enable most features without any extra requirements. Essentials is not available on the Google Play Store; instead, it can be downloaded from its official GitHub Repository in APK format. To unlock all of Essentials' features, a crucial step is enabling restricted settings within the app itself. This involves navigating to Settings > Apps > See all X apps > Essentials and tapping the three-dot menu to access additional options. Upon accessing the restricted settings page, tap "Allow restricted settings" to grant permission for full functionality. Without this feature enabled, Essentials' capabilities will be severely limited by Android's permissions system. The user interface of Essentials is straightforward: users can search for specific features and toggle them on or off with ease. However, enabling certain features requires granting numerous permissions to the app, which may seem like a chore but ultimately yields significant benefits. One notable feature within Essentials is App Lock, allowing users to require authentication before accessing specific apps. This functionality is particularly useful when handling sensitive information, such as banking details, and can be enabled by granting Essentials permission for Accessibility features. Enabling App Lock in Android devices requires navigating to Essentials > Security and Privacy, where the feature can be toggled on by clicking the On/Off slider. Granting necessary permission for Accessibility features is then required, prompting a request to authenticate with fingerprint, face, or password/PIN. Once authenticated, users can select locked apps from the next page by tapping "Select locked apps" and choosing which applications require authentication before opening. Apps such as 2FA tools, banking apps, and messaging services are ideal candidates for locking, ensuring sensitive information remains protected. For instance, Authy, bank apps, and Messages can be set to require authentication each time they're opened. Essentials offers a wide range of features that can be accessed through its user-friendly interface, providing users with more control over their Android devices than what's available in standard Settings menus. To unlock these features, users will need to grant numerous permissions, some of which may require root access or the use of Shizuku, an open-source tool that grants third-party apps system-level privileges without fully rooting a device. Additionally, enabling wireless debugging is necessary for Shizuku to function properly. For those willing to invest time and effort into customizing their Android experience, Essentials offers unparalleled control and flexibility, making it an indispensable tool for power users looking to get the most out of their devices. articles.title: Google DeepMind Employees Seek Union Recognition with CAC Application
articles.summary: A union recognition application has been filed by Google DeepMind staff through the Communication Workers Union and Unite the Union.
articles.content: Google DeepMind staff have taken their fight to unionize to the next level by filing an application with the Central Arbitration Committee, a government body that mediates disputes between employers and unions. The Communication Workers Union and Unite the Union, representing the Google DeepMind employees, are seeking confirmation from the CAC that they have enough support among staff to trigger a unionization ballot. This move comes after a series of meetings with company representatives failed to yield results, leaving employees feeling disregarded. Google DeepMind would be legally bound to respect the outcome of any subsequent unionization vote, which could see around 1,000 product-focused staff become eligible for union membership. The push for unionization began in February 2025, following Alphabet's removal of a pledge from its ethics guidelines that it wouldn't use AI for purposes like weapons development. Employees have expressed frustration with management, claiming their concerns are being minimized and ignored. John Chadfield, national officer for technology at the CWU, commented on the situation: "They've been ignored. They feel like their problems have been minimized." Google DeepMind employees pushing for unionization are voicing their concerns about the company's involvement with military forces in the US and Israel. They feel that this partnership is a significant departure from Google's initial mission to benefit humanity and create a better world. According to an anonymous employee, the company had emphasized its commitment to certain principles when they were hired, but those ideals seem to be being compromised by the agreements made with government organizations. The employees are worried about the direction of AI technology under these circumstances. Google has maintained that its deals with government agencies are part of a broader effort to provide AI services and infrastructure in support of national security. Google DeepMind staff are urging their colleagues in the UK to participate in a unionization ballot, which is expected to take place in the coming months. The employees involved in the push for unionization want collective bargaining and a say in how AI is developed and deployed. They believe that this will help establish checks and balances within an industry that has significant power over the economy. In their efforts to unionize, Google DeepMind staff are also hoping to create a playbook that can be followed by employees at other major AI labs, such as OpenAI and Anthropic in the UK. The lack of opportunities for employees or regulators to have any checks and balances within this industry has raised concerns among those pushing for unionization. articles.title: Instant access to new credit cards offered by some issuers
articles.summary: Cardholders can start using their new card immediately after approval, meeting requirements for welcome bonuses and introductory APR offers.
articles.content: Credit card issuers are starting to offer instant gratification for their new customers. With some issuers, you can get instant access to your new credit card by receiving an instant card number or being able to add it to a digital wallet after approval. This convenience allows cardholders to start using their new card immediately, whether it's for meeting the welcome bonus spending requirement or making a purchase right away. The clock starts ticking on these requirements as soon as your account is approved, not when your physical card arrives in the mail. Instant access can also be useful if you need to book travel or take advantage of a 0% introductory APR offer. Some cobranded store credit cards even offer discounts on purchases starting from the moment you use the card. Eligible approved cardholders can receive instant access to their new account number via various digital platforms, allowing them to add their card to a digital wallet immediately after approval. The Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card offers 75,000 bonus miles after spending $4,000 on purchases in the first three months from account opening, and approved cardholders can receive instant access to their account number via the Capital One app. A similar offer is available with the Capital One Venture Rewards Credit Card, which also provides 75,000 bonus miles after spending $4,000 within the first three months from account opening. Plus, cardholders receive a $300 credit to use on hotel and vacation rentals booked through Capital One Travel in the first year. Approved cardholders can add their card to digital wallets with Spend Instantly, a feature offered by the Chase Sapphire Preferred Card, which earns 75,000 bonus points after spending $5,000 on purchases in the first three months from account opening. The annual fee for this card is $95. The Chase Sapphire Reserve Card offers an even more lucrative deal, providing 100,000 bonus points after spending $6,000 on purchases in the first three months from account opening, but it comes with a higher annual fee of $795. Eligible approved cardholders can also add their card to digital wallets with Spend Instantly. The instant card number provided by American Express is the same as the physical card received in the mail, except for the four-digit card identification number on the front of the card, which will be different. This allows customers to start using their new card immediately after approval, without having to wait for the physical card to arrive. Applicants for certain credit cards may need to wait before setting up recurring payments, as their instant card numbers are not immediately available for all transactions. Instant card numbers from cobranded cards like those issued by Delta, Hilton, or Marriott can only be used with the associated company's services. When ordering replacement cards, existing American Express cardholders can access their card information instantly, a feature also extended to new cardmembers who receive instant card numbers upon approval. Not all Amex personal and business cards offer this convenience, however, with notable exceptions including the Amazon Business Card and the Amazon Business Prime Card, which have been separately researched by our team. A few top American Express options that do provide instant card numbers include the Platinum, Gold, and Blue Cash Preferred Cards from American Express, as well as the Hilton Honors American Express Aspire Card. Some Bank of America checking account holders may receive targeted promotions offering an instant card number for specific cards, such as the Bank of America Premium Rewards credit card, but this is not a standard practice and should be treated as an exception. When applying for certain credit cards, cardholders can access their virtual card numbers immediately after approval, allowing them to start using the account without waiting for a physical card to arrive in the mail. This feature is available on some Capital One credit cards, which provide instant card numbers upon approval through their mobile app. Users can retrieve their virtual card number on the same page where they check their application status, provided they have been approved for the card. While this convenience may be appealing to those who need access to a new account quickly, it's essential to note that these virtual card numbers are designed for immediate use rather than as a security measure. Capital One also offers virtual card numbers specifically designed to protect against unauthorized purchases, which serve a different purpose and should not be confused with instant card numbers. In addition to Capital One, other credit card issuers offer instant access to approved accounts through various methods, such as the Cardless app, which provides cobranded credit cards that can be used without a physical card. Chase credit card holders can access their digital wallets through the Chase app, but first they need to navigate to "Account services" and then select "Digital wallets. From there, they can choose which mobile wallet they want to add their card to. This process allows users to make purchases at merchants that accept digital wallets, but some cards are excluded from this feature. Mastercards, Amazon cards, and business cards cannot be used immediately through the app. Citi is another issuer that offers instant card numbers for select cards if the application is approved instantly and identity verification is completed successfully. Eligible applicants will see a Get Card Number Today" option after approval, followed by "See Card Summary". The temporary card number and security code can only be viewed once, so it's essential to write them down immediately. The Costco Anywhere Visa Card by Citi operates differently, as eligible applicants may receive a temporary barcode that can be used exclusively for Costco purchases. Availability of instant credit card numbers varies by card, and some cards are excluded from this feature altogether. articles.title: Google Introduces Memory Summary Feature for Gemini Users
articles.summary: The feature allows users to view and edit data collected by Google's AI-powered Gemini service.
articles.content: Google's Gemini AI has been collecting information about users' conversations and personal details, raising concerns about data privacy and potential misuse. The company has now introduced a feature to allow users to view and edit this stored data. The new "Memory summary option provides a comprehensive overview of the details that Gemini has gathered over time, including user-submitted information and insights derived from conversations. This transparency is a significant step towards empowering users to manage their online presence and data. The Memory summary feature is accessible across all platforms where Gemini is available, including web, mobile (iOS and Android), and desktop apps for Windows and Mac. Users can access it by launching the app or website and navigating to the settings menu. To view and edit stored data, users must first ensure that the Memory feature is turned on. If the option is grayed out, they need to activate it in the Personal Intelligence section of the settings screen. Once active, users can review and modify their stored information as needed. The introduction of the Memory summary feature marks a significant development in Gemini's design, highlighting Google's efforts to balance AI-driven personalization with user data protection and control. The Memory summary feature in Gemini allows users to view their individual details categorized by Essentials, Business & Career, Reading & Interests, and Culinary Preferences. This categorization helps users quickly identify and review the information stored about them. To access a recent history of changes and updates to Gemini's memory, tap the three dot-icon at the top and select Memory history. Users can edit their personal details in Gemini if they find them too sensitive or incorrect. On the website or desktop apps, clicking the pencil icon at the top allows direct editing of text to add, remove, or revise specific details. After making changes, users simply need to click Save for the updates to sync across all platforms. In a test scenario, a user's summary incorrectly listed their residence as Madison County when they actually live in New York. To correct this, the user revised the text and saved the changes, which then reflected across both the website and apps seamlessly. For users without direct editing capabilities on mobile apps, there is an alternative method to make changes that works on both desktop and mobile devices. Users can simply type and speak their request for a change at a prompt, allowing Gemini's AI to carry out the update accordingly. By offering these features, Google aims to strike a balance between personalization and user data control in its AI-driven search engine, Gemini. To edit Gemini's Memory feature, users must first log in to their Google account and access the Gemini settings page. From there, they can select Memory" and then click on the three vertical dots next to a specific item, such as a business or hobby. Once an item is selected, users are presented with options to edit or remove it from Gemini's memory. For example, if a user has previously mentioned running a fictional business called Batter Up selling collectible baseball cards, they can choose to delete that detail and update Gemini's knowledge about them. By offering this level of control over its memory, Google aims to strike a balance between personalization and user data protection in its AI-driven search engine. This feature allows users to review and correct the information stored by Gemini, ensuring that it accurately reflects their preferences and activities. Users can now manage what Gemini remembers about them, enabling a more controlled experience with the AI-powered search engine. articles.title: Ukraine Restricts Access to Starshield Satellite Internet Service
articles.summary: Ukraine has restricted its access to the Starshield satellite internet service due to unknown reasons, potentially hindering its military efforts against Russia.
articles.content: Ukraine is facing yet another challenge in its ongoing conflict as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that the country's access to Starshield, a military version of the satellite internet service Starlink, has been restricted. The move comes at a critical time for Ukraine, with envoys from the US, led by Trump representatives, engaged in talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow. The international community is watching closely as tensions between Russia and Ukraine remain high. Zelenskyy's announcement suggests that Ukraine's military efforts may be compromised. The restrictions are reportedly being imposed along the entire front line of the conflict and in areas under Russian control. According to Zelenskyy, any terminal moving at a speed above 161 km/h loses its connection to the Starshield network. This means that Ukraine's military communication channels will be severely impacted, potentially hindering their ability to respond effectively. Investigations by Ukraine's defense minister and top commander have ruled out random errors as the cause of the restrictions, leaving officials uncertain about the reasons behind this latest development. Ukraine is facing a significant setback in its defense against Russia, as President Volodymyr Zelenskyy revealed that the country's access to Starshield has been slowed again, compromising their ability to intercept Russian drones. The impact of this development is already being felt on the ground, with Zelenskyy stating that it is allowing Russia to carry out more accurate strikes against Ukraine. This, in turn, puts Ukrainian lives at risk and undermines the country's efforts to defend itself. The situation has left officials scrambling to understand why Starshield access has been restricted. Ukraine's interceptor drones rely on Starshield to chase down Russian Shahed drones, which can reach speeds of up to 500 km/h. However, with their access slowed, Ukraine's interceptors are struggling to keep pace, leaving them vulnerable to attack. As a result, some strikes have already managed to get through, compromising Ukrainian defenses. The timing of this development is particularly curious, given the recent arrival in Moscow of US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner for talks with Putin. It remains to be seen how these diplomatic efforts will impact Ukraine's situation, but one thing is clear: the country needs Starshield to operate at full capacity if it is to effectively defend itself against Russian aggression. The mystery surrounding the throttling of Starshield continues to deepen as Ukraine's defense capabilities remain under threat. According to US officials cited by Reuters, the initial decision to slow down Starshield was made from within the White House, but it remains unclear who specifically gave the order. Musk's involvement in the slowdown has been a subject of confusion, with various statements that have left more questions than answers. Initially, he claimed that Starshield is "owned and controlled by the US government," only to later suggest that Ukraine had breached Starlink's terms of service. This inconsistency raises concerns about Musk's role in the decision-making process. The situation has been further complicated by Trump's denial of any involvement, which adds to the uncertainty surrounding the throttling of Starshield. The fact that speeds were restored on October 24 after bipartisan lawmakers applied pressure suggests that external influence can be a powerful force in resolving these issues, but for now, Ukraine's defense capabilities remain compromised.
